paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea. What you do with God's Word NOW matters, because the time to listen is while you're still living. Jesus tells the Pharisees, who were lovers of money, that "God knows your hearts." Then He tells a story where the rich man had every comfort at his gate and never saw the man lying there (Luke 16:15, 19-21).

Look at what the rich man asks for at the end. He wants someone sent from the dead to warn his five brothers. Abraham answers, "They have Moses and the Prophets; let your brothers listen to them," and then, "If they do not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead" (Luke 16:29, 31). So the problem was never a shortage of signs, friend. It was a heart that wouldn't listen to what God had already said.

So here's what I want you to carry out of my bakery. God's Word is already in your hands, and that is a BIG gift. Don't wait for a louder sign or a better moment, and don't hold tight to the things people prize while God's Word sits right there waiting. Open it, listen, and let it change you today, and my ovens will be warm for you the whole way.
